english.title: Channel tunnel - make false statement relating to goods to employee / agent
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) in relation to goods, namely **(..SPECIFY GOODS..), which were intended for carriage on a Channel Tunnel train, made to **(..SPECIFY PERSON..), an employee or agent of

(A)_[the concessionaire,]_
(B)_[the owner of a channel tunnel train,]_
(C)_[the operator of a channel tunnel train,]_
(D)_[the train manager of a channel tunnel train,]_
(E)_[a person permitted to have access to a restricted zone and who had control in that restricted zone over the said goods,]_
(G)_[a security approved channel tunnel freight forwarder,]_

a statement which you knew to be false in a material particular or recklessly made to the said **(..SPECIFY PERSON..) a statement which was false in a material particular in that **(..SPECIFY FALSIFICATION..)
english.legislation: Contrary to article 29(1) and (4) of the Channel Tunnel (Security) Order 1994.

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: See also associated offence wording at: H1151 re false statements made to the actual operator owner concessionaire etc.

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale.

6 months
